subject.title: [RE-OPEN REQUEST] Indexing sync failure for jjr-iot-skill (Previous #2047)

question: Should maintainers restore public visibility for `janeXlab/jjr-iot-skill` after auditing production account, publisher, skill/version, scan/moderation, deletion, license, audit, and digest state?
rationale: Automation cannot safely decide or repair this from public endpoints because the necessary production account and moderation state is private and public exposure must preserve ClawHub trust gates.

options.title: Audit and restore through existing gates
options.body: Inspect the production state and restore the skill through the existing publish/admin path only if ownership, scan, moderation, deletion, license, and audit checks pass.

options.title: Keep hidden and explain the gate
options.body: If account verification or safety state does not pass, leave the skill hidden and give the reporter an owner-visible remediation path.

options.title: Wait for reporter login confirmation
options.body: Defer visibility changes until the reporter confirms they can access the expected ClawHub account or publisher.

recommendation.title: Audit and restore through existing gates
recommendation.body: Inspect the production state and restore the skill through the existing publish/admin path only if ownership, scan, moderation, deletion, license, and audit checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: He is CODEOWNERS-listed for the relevant backend API and publishing paths and already asked the reporter to verify ClawHub login for this issue.
